plan.description: Cerebrate produces the directive and delivery shape (single/multi/brood).

brood_confirm.description: Surface normalized strain task text for explicit user approval before dispatching the brood.

spawn_brood.description: Launch child overlord instances via the deterministic spawn substrate, then enter hatchery monitor mode.

git_preflight.description: Overlord verifies git state is safe before branch creation.

branch.description: Create or confirm the compliant working branch.

implement_next_step.description: Explicit loop head replacing a generic foreach: branch back to implement_step while steps remain, forward when all steps complete.

implement_step.description: Overlord delegates the current step to a static-allowed bioform, picked by intent (no dynamic agent resolution).

checkpoint.description: Molt a checkpoint commit after the completed step.

version_bump_decision.description: Overlord judges whether a version bump is required.

version_bump.description: Drone applies the version bump across artifacts.

version_checkpoint.description: Molt a checkpoint commit for the version bump.

validate.description: Overlord runs validation and judges pass/fail.

local_review_decision.description: Overlord decides whether local pre-PR review runs (Codex present and opted in) or is skipped.

local_review.description: Local reviewer runs the pre-PR adaptation cycle; reviewer-return outcomes are named transitions, not overlord prose.

review_remediation_plan.description: Cerebrate re-plans remediation when review escalates to the planner.

open_pr.description: Open the pull request for the completed plan.

github_review_decision.description: Overlord decides how to handle GitHub review: watch loop, one-shot fix, or none.

github_review_loop.description: Watch the PR and remediate review feedback until a terminal condition; reviewer-return outcomes are named transitions.

github_reviewer_fix.description: One-shot GitHub reviewer fix pass; reviewer-return outcomes are named transitions.
